with i, so a flat n over-samples the small scales (where the correction is
already resolved hundreds of times over) and starves the large ones (where
it has sunk below the noise). A flat n=20000 pilot on this ladder returned

The rule's own 'omega1' is a DESIGN input, not an estimate -- it shapes the
sample counts, and the fit is insensitive to getting it roughly right.
